items.title: Joe Wilder Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 12, 1998
items.q: Nat Shapiro... he’s the one who promoted me, I mean for that record and for “Peter Gunn.”

ctx.x: When was the first opportunity to get with a major label, under your own name?

That was when I did an album called “The Pretty Sound” for Columbia. And Nat Shapiro, that’s who — I couldn’t think of Nat’s name — he’s the one who promoted me, I mean for that record and for “Peter Gunn.” He was responsible for that. But that was the first time. I did some things for Savoy, but nothing, as far as I’m concerned, of the quality of the Columbia things.
Well I noticed in looking, this was recorded it says January 18, 1959. So you had one day to do ten songs.
